name: Apex Algs 2026
information: # APEX ALGS 2026 HAS BEEN CANCELLED due to the winter storm. Please check your email. **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApexAlgs2026#63000-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. **Due to space limitations, each competitor is only allowed to bring TWO guests with them to the competition.
